title: Quote: I'm not a 62-year-old statesman that's traveled around the w...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Jobs Talks About His Rise and Fall
content: I'm not a 62-year-old statesman that's traveled around the world all his life. So I'm sure that there was a situation when I was 25 that if I could go back, knowing what I know now, I could have handled much better. And I'm sure I'll be able to say the same thing when I'm 35 about the situation in 1985. I can be very intense in my convictions. And I don't know; all in all, I kind of like myself and I'm not that anxious to change.
